text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! How do you like this beautiful 
voice?! I have fully recovered from the 
curse of the Death Spicy Sauce!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Dober, my rival for the upcoming Shuka 
Sho, is right there in the stands! I'll 
show her what I'm made of!
